record.question: Which country has the highest medals tally in the 11th South Asian Games held at Dhaka?
record.explanation: Olympic Council of Asia's Dhaka 2010 results rank India first, with 90 gold, 55 silver and 29 bronze. India also leads total medals. The Ministry's 2010–11 annual report corroborates first place; do not copy inconsistent later numerical tallies from secondary accounts. Historical exam context: 2010-03-24 (full date printed on cover). This is the source-era answer; time-sensitive roles, rankings and memberships may have changed. Evidence: https://oca.asia/games/16-dhaka-2010.html Independently checked solution, unofficial. No matching examiner answer key is asserted.
